site_audit.html_errors: 4 errors, 5 warnings, 0 info on the homepage. Errors: no doctype before the start tag; two CSS negative padding values (-4em and -2px); and the head is missing a required <title> element. Warnings: a redundant type attribute on two style elements, a Unicode Private Use Area glyph, a redundant type attribute on a JavaScript resource, and no lang attribute on the html start tag.

issues: The homepage has no <title> element at all - the W3C checker reports 'Element head is missing a required instance of child element title'.
Your Khammam ad sends people to gloled.co, where the only Khammam content is one line in a fourteen-outlet list on /contact-us/.
The landing page opens with no doctype before the start tag and carries two CSS rules with negative padding values (-4em and -2px).

The contact form is a Zoho Forms embed that asks for a Sales Rep Name before it will accept an enquiry, and its widget markup carries Zoho's own error strings, including 'Your form has been deactivated.'
No prices are published anywhere - the catalogue is a PDF and the only pricing language on the site is the ad's 'Special Pricing for Bulk Requirements'.
No Meta Pixel installed — can't run retargeting or track ad conversions
No Google Ads / GTM tracking — can't measure ad performance
No Google Analytics — flying blind on website traffic

site_evidence.note: Landing-page source read live on 2026-11-10 through the W3C Nu HTML Checker (validator.w3.org/nu/?doc=<url>&showsource=yes), which returns the served HTML with script tags intact, plus a direct fetch of the same pages. Tags found: no Meta Pixel, GA4, GTM or Google Ads tag confirmed.

promise_gap: Ad: 'Need Solar Street Lights in Bulk in Khammam? ... Bulk Orders Welcome, Multiple Wattages Available, Suitable for Roads, Layouts & Projects, Reliable Solar Lighting Solutions, Special Pricing for Bulk Requirements, Khammam & Nearby Areas. Call / WhatsApp: 70365 33794.'

The bulk, multi-wattage and project claims are backed - gloled.co carries a Solar Lights product line, a Projects page and a catalogue PDF, and the Khammam outlet at 11-10-268/6/A/1 near the New RTC Bus Stand is listed on /contact-us/. But the ad sends the click to https://gloled.co/, where the Khammam address is one line among fourteen outlets and there is no price, no wattage table and no bulk-order form. The phone number in the ad, 70365 33794, is not one of the numbers published on the site.
Ad: 'Send your requirement today and get a quotation from our team.'

The only route to a quotation is a Zoho Forms embed that asks for a Sales Rep Name and a CAPTCHA before it will accept the enquiry, and whose widget markup carries Zoho's own error strings including 'Your form has been deactivated.' There is no price list to compare against.
Ad destination: https://gloled.co/ - confirmed on the ad card.

The site itself has no <title> element on the homepage, no doctype before the start tag and two CSS rules with negative padding values, so the page the ad pays for is the least finished asset in the funnel. The Khammam outlet is a real, verifiable presence - it is on /contact-us/ with a Google Maps directions link - but nothing on the landing page points at it.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
